story: I'm Sabrina Muqadas, a Business Development Representative and Executive with experience in lead generation, proposal writing, Upwork bidding and client engagement across the USA, UK, UAE and KSA.
I progressed from KYCIER Team Lead to Upwork Bidder, building real depth in data management, pipeline optimization and sales intelligence along the way.

My experience spans IT services, software development, mobile applications, websites and digital marketing. I translate client requirements into suitable business and technology solutions, and I use AI tools to streamline research, proposals and decision-making.

pillars.title: Business mindset
pillars.text: Growth starts with understanding. I look for the real business need behind a request, then connect it to a suitable solution.

pillars.title: Technology understanding
pillars.text: From software and mobile apps to websites and digital marketing, I know the services well enough to present them clearly and credibly.

pillars.title: Continuous learning
pillars.text: Tools and AI workflows keep changing how sales teams work. I keep learning and bring them into research, proposals and decisions.

pillars.title: Values and approach
pillars.text: Structured, research-led and clear in communication. Clean data, organised pipelines, and helping teammates grow through mentoring.

experience.progression: Internal progression: Team Lead to Upwork Bidder

roles.title: Upwork Bidder / Business Development Executive
roles.overview: Owned proposal and Upwork profile optimization, using AI tools to move faster and applying IT knowledge to present technology services to prospective clients.
responsibilities: Tailored proposals and optimized Upwork profiles to improve win rates.
Used AI tools, including ChatGPT, Grok, and the Upwork toolkit, to enhance proposal efficiency.
Identified relevant projects and potential business opportunities.
Contacted prospective clients through email and phone.
Engaged with clients to understand requirements and offer suitable solutions.
Applied IT knowledge to effectively present technology services and solutions.

roles.title: KYCIER — Lead Generation & Data Management
roles.overview: Led lead generation and data management: researching markets, qualifying leads, building client profiles, delivering website health reports and mentoring the team.
responsibilities: Generated and qualified high-potential leads using Google, LinkedIn, and advanced data scraping tools.
Researched markets and client requirements to improve outreach and conversions.
Built detailed client profiles using manual research, RocketReach, Sales Navigator, and automation scripts.
Delivered website health reports covering UI/UX, SEO, and technical quality.
Streamlined data and pipeline management using Google Sheets, Microsoft Word, and Excel.
Mentored and trained team members and interns.
Conducted meetings and process improvement initiatives.

roles.title: Senior Recruiter & Content Manager
roles.overview: Supported talent acquisition for the oil and gas industry across Gulf countries, particularly the UAE, alongside content for brand presence.
responsibilities: Supported talent acquisition for the oil and gas industry across Gulf countries, particularly the UAE.
Managed candidate sourcing, proposals, and candidate meetings.
Created engaging visual and written content using Canva to support brand presence.

growthStrategy.title: Market Research
growthStrategy.description: Understanding the markets, industries and competitors where a company wants to grow, before a single message is sent.
activities: Research target markets across the USA, UK, UAE and KSA
Map industry trends and competitor positioning
Identify service demand and segments worth pursuing
growthStrategy.outcome: A clear view of where the best opportunities are, so effort goes to the right markets.

growthStrategy.title: Ideal Customer Profile & Buyer Persona
growthStrategy.description: Defining who the right-fit client is, what they need and who makes the buying decision.
activities: Build ideal customer profiles from company data
Create buyer personas and identify decision-makers
Profile target accounts before outreach (KYC-style research)
growthStrategy.outcome: A shared definition of the right client that sharpens targeting and messaging.

growthStrategy.title: Lead Discovery & Qualification
growthStrategy.description: Finding matching companies and contacts, then qualifying them before anyone is contacted.
activities: Source leads with Google, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and scraping tools
Enrich contacts with tools such as RocketReach, Apollo and Hunter.io
Qualify against the profile and keep data clean in Google Sheets
growthStrategy.outcome: A verified, prioritised prospect list that keeps the pipeline healthy.

growthStrategy.title: Outreach & Engagement
growthStrategy.description: Starting relevant conversations through the right channel, with a message tailored to the prospect.
activities: Personalised LinkedIn and email outreach
Cold calling where it fits
Proposal-led engagement on Upwork
growthStrategy.outcome: Quality conversations with the right decision-makers.

growthStrategy.title: Discovery & Requirement Analysis
growthStrategy.description: Listening first: understanding goals, constraints and scope before recommending anything.
activities: Ask structured discovery questions
Clarify scope, goals and constraints
Match requirements to suitable software, web, mobile or marketing services
growthStrategy.outcome: A requirement picture clear enough to propose the right solution.

growthStrategy.title: Proposal & Negotiation
growthStrategy.description: Turning requirements into a clear, tailored proposal and supporting the conversation to agreement.
activities: Write tailored proposals and cover letters
Position services in the client's own language
Support negotiation and coordinate with delivery teams
growthStrategy.outcome: Relevant, clear proposals and a smoother path to agreement.

growthStrategy.title: Conversion & Client Relationship
growthStrategy.description: Moving opportunities over the line and starting the client relationship well.
activities: Follow up and move opportunities toward close
Coordinate hand-over with the delivery team
Keep communication open after the sale
growthStrategy.outcome: New clients who start well and stay engaged.

growthStrategy.title: Performance Analysis & Optimization
growthStrategy.description: Reviewing what worked and what did not, then feeding the learning back into the next cycle.
activities: Review pipeline and proposal performance
Refine targeting, messaging and profiles
Automate repeatable steps with scripts and AI tools
growthStrategy.outcome: Learning that feeds back into stage one, so the process improves each cycle.
